repos.description: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows
repos.hook: This tool converts PlayStation 5 game programs to run on personal computers. It supports Linux and Windows operating systems. The software translates the code automatically without manual edits.

repos.description: Next generation e2e testing framework for web and mobile apps.
repos.hook: This tool tests web and mobile applications from start to finish. We call this process end-to-end testing. End-to-end testing checks that an entire user workflow works without errors.
repos.personalization: As a fullstack engineer, this gives you a fresh option for testing full user journeys across your web apps.

repos.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repos.hook: This repository contains custom skills for AI coding agents. Agents are automated programs that write software. These skills give agents clear steps for real engineering tasks.
repos.personalization: Useful to inspect if you are actively evaluating how to package custom workflows for terminal-based coding agents.

repos.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
repos.hook: This tool keeps agent memory alive across different coding sessions. It records what an agent does and compresses the log. Then, it loads that past context into new sessions.
repos.personalization: Directly relevant to your evaluation of AI coding tools and your work managing prompt context over time.

repos.description: A native, user-mode, multi-process, graphical debugger.
repos.hook: This program helps developers find errors in code. We call this type of tool a debugger. A debugger pauses a running program so you can inspect memory and variables.

repos.description: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
repos.hook: This tool generates video files from standard web code. AI agents write HTML markup to control the visual frames. Then, the tool renders that markup into animated video.

repos.description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
repos.hook: This repository defines rules for extensions in the Cursor editor. Extensions add new features to an existing software program. It also contains official plugins for AI-assisted programming.
repos.personalization: Helpful for your benchmarking of AI code editors and for exploring how editor-level agent extensions are built.

repos.description: Flutter makes it easy and fast to build beautiful apps for mobile and beyond
repos.hook: Flutter is a framework for building apps from one shared codebase. A codebase is the collection of source code for a software project. It compiles directly to mobile, web, and desktop devices.

This tool helps AI agents generate three-dimensional models from plain text descriptions. Engineers use computer-aided design to create physical parts. The software converts text instructions into precise 3D design files.

repos.description: Build your own network of agents from Claude Code, Codex and Pi: persistent teams with roles, shared context and owned work.
repos.hook: This platform organizes multiple AI coding agents into a single collaborative team. It shares context between different tools like Claude Code and Codex. Each agent receives specific roles and manages dedicated work.
repos.personalization: Directly fits your applied AI work on evaluating multi-agent coordination and prompt handoffs.

repos.description: ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English rules, repurposed as a Claude Code skill for rewriting ambiguous agent-facing English.
repos.hook: This tool rewrites text into Simplified Technical English for language models. Simplified Technical English removes ambiguous phrases and complex grammar. Clear language helps AI models execute tasks with fewer mistakes.
repos.personalization: Directly applicable to your prompt optimization work, giving you a formal rule system to make prompts unambiguous.

repos.description: A context-compression plugin for small context windows (a 100K context is enough), token savings (5x fewer tokens), and month-long single sessions (billions of tokens).上下文压缩插件，兼顾小窗口(100k上下文足矣)省token(省5倍token)和超长会话(数月级别几十亿token单会话)。billion-context is all you need
repos.hook: This plugin compresses prompt text during long AI sessions. It reduces the total token count by up to five times. Tokens are the basic text units that language models read and charge for.
repos.personalization: Directly aligns with your applied prompt evaluation work where context window size and token costs matter.
